name: Lash icon
description: UI slot icon for the mandible lash. Composes the real `ss.proj.slash` arc via `use` at a quarter scale, so retuning the weapon's sweep restyles its icon in the same edit. Rim is `$white` — the bone the mandible is, bleached. It was `$husk`, three quarters of what this icon draws, until the Pulse Rate passive that wears this rim had to read as white beside the Shell's grey; the mandible inside keeps its husk, so the rim is the bone a step whiter rather than a colour from somewhere else.

evolved.description: Cowboy. The rim goes gold the way every evolved slot does, and the one crescent becomes the two turns the evolution swings: the lash all the way round, then back again. Both are the same `ss.proj.slash` the base slot composes, placed on the centre of the circle its arc is cut from (local [6.4, 5.0], r 34.7) so they wind round one point. The forehand is the outer arc, open on the left; the backhand is the inner, turned 180° so it opens the other way. Two arcs at one radius closed into an O and read as an eye, not a swing — two radii make a spiral, and a spiral is a turn with a direction. Composed rather than drawn again, so retuning the sweep restyles both slots in the same edit.
